title: Weyl forms in parabolic contact geometries
summary: In a parabolic contact geometry a choice of contact form determines a Weyl form consisting of three components: a soldering form, a Weyl connection, and a Rho tensor. An explicit description of the soldering form is well-known. We express the Rho tensor in terms of the Weyl connection in the setting of torsion-free normal parabolic contact geometries. Parabolic contact geometries with a specified contact form have a second canonical connection, the Tanaka-Webster connection.
